notes_for_editor: Almost no history found. The Forest Lookouts Rhodes page holds only a heading and the county, so nothing about construction, staffing, fires or removal is recorded. The record's coordinates match the Forest Fire Lookout Association list. Two WebSearch queries were used (budget spent). Search snippets from Cecil County History (a Facebook post and cecilcountyhistory.com's 'Fire Towers Once Provided Early Warnings in Cecil') say Cecil County once had three Maryland Forest Service spotter towers, but they are not confirmed to include Rhodes; both sites refused the reader (HTTP 403 or no body text), so they are not cited. The DNR Fire Tower Report covers surviving DNR towers in Cecil County (Black Hill, Pleasant Hill site) and does not mention Rhodes. Needed: a Maryland Forest Service, Cecil County history or MIHP source for build date, staffing, removal, and what the summit is like now.
